method: Each of the seven final CPU reimport render images was opened and inspected as pixels after export. Two real bus reference photos were inspected as pixels before modelling.
scope: Offline asset visual QA; not runtime, WebGL, photographic identity or accessibility acceptance

reviewedRenders.observation: Blue shaped paired seats, yellow bent poles, open longitudinal aisle, yellow-edged rear steps, rear bench and overhead fittings are visible; recognizably matches the reviewed Vancouver low-floor visual vocabulary.
Seatbacks, silver grab handles, hanging straps and forward driver/fare area are visible. Continuous central aisle and change of rear floor height remain legible.
Rear doorway remains visually open beside the low-floor area; two risers, nosings, wheel housings and adjacent seats are visible. Stop cord does not cross the open portal.
Open front entry, driver chair, partition, open steering ring, dashboard and simplified fare reader remain distinct. Details are representative, not a surveyed cockpit.
Two raised steps, aisle, forward-facing rear seats, stop button and five-place rear bench are legible. Seat support and wheel-housing approximations are retained.

QA-only upper-surface removal exposes six low-floor seats, twelve paired rear seats, five rear-bench places, driver area, open bay and stepped aisle. The stripped upper vent appears detached only because the exterior/ceiling are omitted in this cutaway.
The same composition preserves seating, raised rear, aisle and rail silhouette while removing straps and upholstery buttons and reducing rounded-edge/cylinder detail.

limitations: Cycles CPU 24-sample images retain visible Monte Carlo grain; they are inspection renders, not noise-free marketing images.
Neutral daylight environment has no city scenery beyond glazing. No night feature or new emissive material is included.
Blank ad panels and unbranded simplified fare/driver equipment are deliberate.
Rear raised deck is seated-only in the existing adapter; full rear free-walk and seat ingress remain pending.
The conservative wheelchair envelope is only 0.60 x 1.50 x 1.40 m and is not accessibility certification.
